parameters.query:
SELECT
    '{{$json.name}}'::text AS name,
    '{{$json.email}}'::text AS email,
    '{{$json.email_domain}}'::text AS email_domain,
    '{{$json.linkedin}}'::text AS linkedin,
    '{{$json.message}}'::text AS message,
    '{{$json.source}}'::text AS source,
    '{{$json.referred_by}}'::text AS referred_by,
    '{{$json.ip_address}}'::text AS ip_address,
    '{{$json.user_agent}}'::text AS user_agent,
    '{{$json.received_at}}'::timestamp AS received_at,
    EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM crm.leads
        WHERE email = '{{$json.email}}'
    ) AS email_exists;

INSERT INTO crm.leads (
  id,
  name, email, company, domain, company_size, industry, segment,
  lead_score, email_sent, status, email_opened, link_clicked,
  assigned_to, notes, linkedin, message, source, referred_by,
  ip_address, created_at
)
VALUES (
  {{ $json.id }},
  '{{ $json.name }}',
  LOWER('{{ $json.email }}'),
  '{{ $json.company }}',
  LOWER('{{ $json.email_domain }}'),
  {{ $json.company_size || 0 }},
  '{{ $json.industry }}',
  '{{ $json.segment }}',
  {{ $json.lead_score || 0 }},
  {{ $json.email_sent || false }},
  '{{ $json.status || "New" }}',
  {{ $json.email_opened || false }},
  {{ $json.link_clicked || false }},
  NULL,
  '{{ $json.notes || "" }}',
  '{{ $json.linkedin || "" }}',
  '{{ $json.message || "" }}',
  '{{ $json.source || "" }}',
  '{{ $json.referred_by || "" }}',
  '{{ $json.ip_address || "" }}',
  '{{ $json.received_at }}'::timestamp
)
RETURNING *;

parameters.query:
UPDATE crm.leads
SET
    status = 'Nurturing',
    email_sent = TRUE,
    last_activity = NOW(),
    email_sequence_stage = 1,
    last_email_sent_at = NOW(),
    next_email_scheduled = NOW() + INTERVAL '2 days',
    sequence_active = TRUE
WHERE id = {{ $('Edit Fields').item.json.id }};

UPDATE crm.leads
SET
    lead_score = lead_score +
        CASE
            WHEN '{{ $json.event_type }}' = 'email_opened' THEN 5
            WHEN '{{ $json.event_type }}' = 'link_clicked' THEN 10
            WHEN '{{ $json.event_type }}' = 'pricing_page_visited' THEN 20
            WHEN '{{ $json.event_type }}' = 'demo_requested' THEN 25
            ELSE 0
        END,
    email_opened = CASE
        WHEN '{{ $json.event_type }}' = 'email_opened' THEN TRUE
        ELSE email_opened
    END,
    link_clicked = CASE
        WHEN '{{ $json.event_type }}' = 'link_clicked' THEN TRUE
        ELSE link_clicked
    END,
    last_activity = NOW()
WHERE id = {{ $json.id }}
RETURNING *;

SELECT
    id,
    name,
    email,
    company,
    segment,
    lead_score,
    status,
    last_activity,
    email_opened,
    link_clicked
FROM crm.leads
WHERE id = {{ $('Normaliser-2').item.json.id }};

SELECT *
FROM crm.leads
WHERE sequence_active = TRUE
  AND next_email_scheduled <= NOW()
  AND email_sequence_stage < 4;

UPDATE crm.leads
SET
  email_sequence_stage = {{ $json.sendEmail }},
  last_email_sent_at = NOW(),
  next_email_scheduled = {{ $json.next_email_scheduled ? ("'" + $json.next_email_scheduled + "'::timestamp") : "NULL" }},
  sequence_active = {{ $json.sequence_active ? 'TRUE' : 'FALSE' }},
  last_activity = NOW()
WHERE id = {{ $json.id }}
RETURNING *;
